answers.core: I can imagine that use cases like this are far from uncommon, and it's a relatively simple extension of the existing featureset of the grid snap configuration window.
answers.workaround: While you can certainly write a `@tool` script to achieve similar behavior, (and indeed I already have such a script that draws a grid dividing the screens), having the behavior built into the editor in the same place as everything else about the grid is certainly far more convenient in terms of usability.

title: Allow configuring the primary line x/y components independently for the 2d editor grid snap
